changelog: The 'Hold the Center' wave mission got a real fix: the waves now actually muster (they were spawning on the impassable edge and never appearing, which made it unwinnable), the arena is half the size so it's not an endless empty field, and each wave only closes in once you've wiped out the last one — or after five turns — instead of piling on top of each other. Plus the usual polish under the hood.
